input.body:
Tested on iPhone. 

Even slight variations to the ancestors or font size can invalidate the steps. 

## Steps to Reproduce

```
- a
  - 📒 Journal
    - 2026
      - 6/5
        - Guiding Light
          - a
          - b
          - c
          - d
          - e
          - Acknowledge
```

1. Set the font size to 13px. 
2. Set the caret on `Acknowledge`. 
3. Scroll so that Acknowledge is close to the bottom of the screen, but not close enough that it will autoscroll when typing (see video). 
4. Type " the ". 
   - If it autoscrolls it means you don't have the scroll position correct. Go back to Step 3. 
5. Type "g"
   - If it _doesn't_ autoscroll it means you don't have the scroll position correct, or the device is the wrong size. Go back to Step 3.

## Current Behavior

When you type "g" it autoscrolls. 

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c6dfb530-96fe-4365-87c0-3637326d770f

## Expected Behavior

When you type "g", no scroll should occur because you already typed "the" on the same line without moving the scroll position.

I originally speculated that it was related to the glyph that extends below the text baseline, but it is also reproducible through typing "a".
input.title: Incorrect autoscroll when close of bottom of screen at 13px
